question: In evidence.zip, use the d99-- member. Collect every exported symbol name, sort strings by ascending code-unit order, join with one LF byte and no trailing LF, then SHA-256 those UTF-8 bytes.

answer_format.syntax: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; no prefix, whitespace, or explanatory text

oracle_cmd: printf %s "$(nm -D --defined-only gf_c_exports.so | awk '{print $3}' | LC_ALL=C sort)" | sha256sum | cut -c1-64
